title: Universal Life Insurance Relationship Pricing Note: CareAssure Claim Waiver of the Full-Surrender Charge
content:
On a full surrender of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy, part of the surrender charge is waived according to the insured's Ashgrove CareAssure claim. The CareAssure policies are the company's Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance (Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year, 3-Year, 4-Year, 5-Year, 6-Year and Lifetime); the facts read are the CareAssure policy's status, which shows whether it is on an active claim, and the long-term care benefit payment entries in its activity history.

## Waiver rule

| CareAssure policy status | Long-term care benefit payments in the last six months | Care waiver |
|---|---|---|
| On an active claim | **3** or more (the full-care number) | Full care waiver, **60%** (0.60) |
| On an active claim | 1 or 2 | Partial care waiver, **30%** (0.30) |
| On an active claim | None | No waiver |
| Not on an active claim | Any number | No waiver |
| No CareAssure policy | not applicable | No waiver |

The charge is multiplied by one less the waiver, by 0.40 with the full waiver and by 0.70 with the partial waiver, before the charge is rounded to the cent.

## Hypothetical cases

- CareAssure policy on an active claim, benefit payments in each of the last four months: 4 payments, full waiver of 60%.
- On an active claim, the only two benefit payments in the last six months: partial waiver of 30%.
- Three benefit payments in the last six months, but the claim has closed and the policy is no longer on an active claim: no waiver.
- A charge of $5000.0000 before the waiver becomes $2000.0000 with the full waiver and $3500.0000 with the partial waiver.
